nodes.name: .claude/CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Concise project guide for Claude Code: mandates use of the .claude/skills/virtuoso-gui-debug skill for Virtuoso window operations, X11 automation, and GUI regression testing. Documents three executor modes (fake/live/local), the validate→run→inspect workflow, the supported scenario DSL ops (VCLI_LOAD, WINDOW_WAIT, KEY, CLICK_REL, DRAG_REL, SCROLL, SCREENSHOT, VERIFY, RECOVER), and pointers to the scenario schema, xdotool cheatsheet, and unit tests.
nodes.languageNotes: Lightweight Markdown with mixed Chinese and English headings/tables. ASCII table comparing three executors; command-line examples use inline backticks.

nodes.name: .claude/settings.json
nodes.summary: Shared Claude Code settings defining PostToolUse hooks. Write|Edit tools trigger .claude/hooks/rust_check.sh to lint/format Rust; Bash commands trigger .claude/hooks/auto_plot.sh and .claude/hooks/eda_error_capture.sh to process plot output and capture EDA stderr. Paths are resolved via $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.
nodes.languageNotes: Standard JSON object with nested hooks[] array; matcher strings and command paths with proper JSON escaping for shell variables.

nodes.name: .claude/settings.local.json
nodes.summary: Local-machine Claude Code permissions override, allowing the Bash tool to invoke `gh run:*` (GitHub Actions run inspection) without prompting.
nodes.languageNotes: Tiny JSON permissions map; uses the tool-name(command-glob) syntax to whitelist a single Bash subcommand family.
